text:
What lonelier bird was seen beneath a roof, or beast on mountain? I am deserted by myself, for you left my soul dissolved in tears.


I shall always weep my greatest good; every morsel is pain and gall; night anguish, rest anxiety, bed battlefield.


Sleep, death's image, surpasses death in cruelty, preventing the supreme good of seeing you.


So great your grace and beauty that, since Nature made you, Nature can perform a miracle.

translation.title: What Lonelier Bird Was Ever Seen beneath a Roof?
